REQ-01.req_text: Staff request annual leave in the app by choosing a start date and an end date.
REQ-01.title: Request leave by choosing dates
REQ-01.goal: to request annual leave in the app by choosing a start date and an end date
REQ-01.benefit: I can book time off without paper forms

criteria.given: a staff member is on the 'Request leave' screen
criteria.when: they choose a start date and an end date and submit
criteria.then: the request is saved and shown as waiting for their line manager

criteria.given: a staff member chooses an end date before the start date
criteria.then: the app blocks the request and explains that the end date must be on or after the start date

REQ-02.req_text: Staff can carry over at most 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.
REQ-02.title: Carry over up to 5 unused days
REQ-02.goal: to carry over up to 5 unused leave days into next year
REQ-02.benefit: I don't lose leave I couldn't take

criteria.given: a staff member has unused annual leave at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: up to 5 unused days are carried over

criteria.given: a staff member has more than 5 unused days at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: only 5 days are carried over and the rest are shown as lost

REQ-03.req_text: Staff get an email when their line manager approves or declines their leave request.
REQ-03.title: Email when my request is decided
REQ-03.goal: to get an email when my line manager approves or declines my leave request
REQ-03.benefit: I know the outcome without checking the app

criteria.given: a staff member has a leave request waiting
criteria.then: the staff member gets an email saying the request was approved, with the dates

criteria.given: a staff member has a leave request waiting
criteria.then: the staff member gets an email saying the request was declined

REQ-04.req_text: Staff can carry over up to 10 unused leave days into the next year.
REQ-04.title: Carry over up to 10 unused days
REQ-04.goal: to carry over up to 10 unused leave days into next year
REQ-04.benefit: I don't lose leave I couldn't take during busy periods

criteria.given: a staff member has unused annual leave at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: up to 10 unused days are carried over

criteria.given: a staff member has more than 10 unused days at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: only 10 days are carried over and the rest are shown as lost
